mapper.select: SELECT id, category_code, created_by, deleted_at FROM restaurants WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT code, name, sort_order, enabled FROM restaurant_categories WHERE code = #{code} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restaurants(name, category_code, price_per_person, price_kind, address, latitude, longitude, coordinate_system, needs_location, business_status, source_type, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryCode}, #{pricePerPerson}, #{priceKind}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{coordinateSystem}, FALSE, #{businessStatus}, 'USER', #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE restaurants SET name=#{row.name}, category_code=#{row.categoryCode}, price_per_person=#{row.pricePerPerson}, price_kind=#{row.priceKind}, address=#{row.address}, latitude=#{row.latitude}, longitude=#{row.longitude}, coordinate_system=#{row.coordinateSystem}, needs_location=FALSE, business_status=#{row.businessStatus}, updated_by=#{actor}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{admin} OR created_by=#{actor})

UPDATE restaurants SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), deleted_by=#{actor}, delete_reason_code=CASE WHEN #{admin} THEN 'ADMIN_REMOVAL' ELSE 'OWNER_REQUEST' END, updated_by=#{actor}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{admin} OR created_by=#{actor})
UPDATE restaurants SET deleted_at=NULL, deleted_by=NULL, delete_reason_code=NULL, updated_by=#{actor}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restaurant_tags(restaurant_id, tag, position) VALUES (#{id}, #{tag}, #{position})
mapper.select: SELECT tag FROM restaurant_tags WHERE restaurant_id=#{id} ORDER BY position
